rows.name: Camera / Video
rows.does: Camera, loaded video, or a moving test picture.

rows.name: Noise
rows.does: Moving cloudy grey noise: a map for Displace, a matte, a texture.

rows.name: Levels / Contrast
rows.does: Black point, white point, gamma.

rows.name: Invert
rows.does: Negative, with an amount.

rows.name: Blur
rows.does: Gaussian blur in pixels.

rows.name: Edge detect
rows.does: White lines where the picture changes brightness.

rows.name: Threshold
rows.does: Pure black and white at a level.

rows.name: Mosaic
rows.does: Flat square cells.

rows.name: Displace
rows.does: Displacement map as in After Effects.

rows.name: Track matte
rows.does: Image shows only where the matte is light (or dark).

rows.name: Mix
rows.does: Mix, add, multiply, screen, difference, max.

rows.name: Ease (time smooth)
rows.does: Every change glides instead of jumping (anti flicker).

rows.name: Echo (trails)
rows.does: Fading ghosts of earlier frames.

rows.name: Palette map
rows.does: Colours with the global palette.

rows.name: Output
rows.does: The preview.

rows.name: Depth
rows.does: Depth map from the video (model). Low power mode first.

rows.name: Subject matte
rows.does: Person cut-out for Track matte.

rows.name: Tone to density
rows.does: The density driver part 1: contrast curve from tone to how crowded the line is.

rows.name: Density range
rows.does: Density driver part 2: closest and widest gap between lines.

rows.name: Serpentine line
rows.does: Runs up and down, straight, sharp turns; run length and turn softness.

rows.name: Meander line
rows.does: Square wave scanlines with Angle, like Scribble.

rows.name: Peano line
rows.does: Adaptive Peano / Hilbert one line.

rows.name: Rotate path
rows.does: Turns a path.

rows.name: Straighten
rows.does: Pulls a path straight.

rows.name: Stroke
rows.does: Draws a path as a line with a width and ink colour.

rows.name: Letters grid
rows.does: Characters on a grid by tone (from Letters).

rows.name: Edge glyphs
rows.does: The - | / \ characters along edges (from Letters_v02).

rows.name: Dots
rows.does: Dots sized by a field (from Depth dots).

rows.name: Circle packing
rows.does: Ishihara circles (from Ishihara_v02).

rows.name: Glow
rows.does: Soft light around bright parts.
rows.notes: Blur + Mix can do a rough version already.

rows.name: Grade (brightness, contrast, saturation)
rows.does: Simple colour grade.
